A few useful answers

How do I place a block?

Select a block, tap a space, then tap Place. The chevrons move the preview; the colored arrow shows gravity. The block’s arrow determines the direction of the entire shift. Full rows and columns clear before pieces settle. Connected fragments move together until a clear splits them.

Can I play without internet or ads?

Yes. Normal puzzle play, retries and new starts work offline. Advertising is disabled in the public launch build. Designated test builds may offer optional Google test ads; they never block normal play.

Where is my saved progress?

Progress is stored on your device, with separate saved attempts for each mode. Keep the app installed when updating. There is no Shift Square account or cloud-sync service. Removing the app or resetting local progress can remove your saves. To reset, use Settings → Reset local progress and confirm.

How does Daily Shift work?

Your device’s local date selects a board from the 1,095-entry catalog. Each daily run has 12 moves. The app keeps your saved attempt and best score for that day.

An optional reward did not appear.

The public launch build does not offer reward ads. In a designated test or later ad-enabled build, availability depends on your connection, privacy choices and ad supply. Previously earned rewards remain part of your save when ads are disabled. If recovery was interrupted, reopen the app or use Settings → Retry saved reward recovery when shown.

How do I change motion, sound or controls?

Open Settings for sound, haptics, reduced motion, direction patterns, high-contrast contours and placement controls. System Reduce Motion is respected.

Reporting an issue

Include your iPhone model, iOS version, app version, the game mode and stage or date, and what happened. Settings → Export diagnostic summary produces a short version-and-totals summary without personal identifiers or full saved boards. Sharing it is your choice.

Please do not send passwords, payment information or other sensitive information. We use your email and report to respond and investigate. Read our privacy policy for details.
